references.text: The same chapter describes the amount of wine for a drink offering for a lamb, which is part of the same sacrificial system.
Describes the drink offering of wine for a ram, part of the same instructions regarding quantities for various sacrifices.
Specifies the amount of wine for a drink offering during monthly sacrifices, with the same measure (one-third of a hin).
Early instruction concerning the drink offering of wine together with the burnt offering.
Describes the burnt offering as a pleasing aroma to the Lord, using the same expression 'reiach nichoach'.
Mentions the drink offering of wine together with the grain offering and the burnt offering.
The first time the expression 'pleasing aroma to the Lord' is used in connection with a sacrifice.
